title: implement support for SAF-T 1.40
summary: Support for SAF-T 1.40 format in Norwegian localization adds handling for new long monetary types and restructured tax amount fields for foreign currency scenarios.
key_points: CurrencyAmount and ExchangeRate now use SAFlongmonetaryType
NOK amount structure updated with DebitTaxAmount and CreditTaxAmount for foreign-currency tax scenarios
New GenerateSAFT14File codeunit added to handle 1.40 format generation
Tests added for new SAF-T 1.40 XML structure
quote: New SAFlongmonetaryType, CurrencyAmount changed to SAFlongmonetaryType, ExchangeRate changed to SAFlongmonetaryType, new NOK amount structure DebitTaxAmount / CreditTaxAmount.
